en.headline: Driver trapped after truck hits traffic light in Tuen Mun
en.dek: A 16-tonne goods vehicle struck a traffic light at Tsing Wun Road and Pui To Road; the driver was conscious with a head injury.
body: A goods-vehicle driver was briefly trapped on Saturday morning after the truck hit a traffic light at the junction of Tsing Wun Road and Pui To Road in Tuen Mun.

Police received a report at about 7:26am. Reports said the 16-tonne vehicle left the carriageway, damaged railings and struck a traffic light, leaving the cab badly deformed. Rescuers freed the driver, who had a head injury and was conscious. He was taken to Tuen Mun Hospital. The cause of the crash was under investigation.

The Transport Department said some lanes on Tsing Wun Road in both directions near Pui To Road were closed because of the crash, and traffic at the junction was busy. Drivers were told to use the remaining lanes.

zh.headline: 屯門貨車撼交通燈 司機一度被困送院
zh.dek: 一輛16噸貨車周六早上在青雲路與杯渡路交界失事，司機頭部受傷、清醒送屯門醫院。
body: 屯門青雲路與杯渡路交界周六早上發生交通意外，一輛貨車撞向交通燈，司機一度被困。
警方約早上7時26分接報。報道指該輛16噸貨車偏離行車線，撞毀欄杆及一支交通燈，車頭嚴重變形。救援人員將司機救出，他頭部受傷但清醒，其後送往屯門醫院治理。意外原因仍在調查。
運輸署表示，因意外關係，青雲路近杯渡路來回方向部分行車線封閉，駕駛人士須使用餘下行車線，現場交通繁忙。
